pixUpdateSection.title: 2 Years of Software & Updates Included
pixUpdateSection.subtitle: A sustainable AI experience with a transparent update model
pixUpdateSection.p1: Orbit Pix includes supported software updates at no additional cost for two years from the purchase date.
pixUpdateSection.p2: At the end of the two-year period, Pix remains usable with its existing features. A USD 20 monthly subscription is available for users who want future software updates.
pixUpdateSection.optionalNotice: A subscription is optional. Pix remains usable with its existing features without one.
pixUpdateSection.faq1Question: Does Orbit Pix require a subscription?
pixUpdateSection.faq1Answer: No. The purchase includes two years of software updates. After that, Pix continues to work with its existing features. Users who want future updates may opt into a USD 20 monthly subscription.
pixUpdateSection.faq2Question: Will Pix stop working if I do not subscribe after two years?
pixUpdateSection.faq2Answer: No. Orbit Pix continues to work with its existing features. The subscription is only for users who want new software updates released after the included two-year period.
